question: Make a finite-population-corrected bootstrap the repo standard for recipient-share intervals: hold complete strata (the certainty 400 and any stratum sampled in full, now every ≥$25m stratum) fixed, or use a rescaling bootstrap with (1 - n_h/N_h). Re-issue the CIs of b40n12, b40n1202-01, b40n120201-01 and b40n1202-b43n26 on that basis
conclusion_affected: Width of every recipient DAF-share interval (headline 1h and 1h-1d-1e)
rationale: The committed bootstrap (rbe.boot) resamples with replacement inside every stratum, including the certainty stratum and strata sampled in full, so it treats a census as a sample. After the ≥$25m census the repo-method SE falls only 4% (1h 0.495 to 0.475 points), while holding complete strata fixed it falls 27% (0.413 to 0.303). The certainty stratum alone contributes 0.26 points of repo-method SE that a census does not have

question: Neyman-allocate a further supplementary sample to the $1-5m and $5-25m bands (and the <$1m strata other than no_ntee and religion): use the per-stratum N_h and the observed SD of numerator and denominator from recipient-census-2026-11-20.csv to allocate about 1,500 more EINs where N_h x S_h is largest, then re-run mission_recipient_census.py
conclusion_affected: Precision of the headline 1h and 1h-1d-1e shares
rationale: With the ≥$25m strata now a census, the remaining census-corrected sampling variance of the headline sits in the <$25m bands: resampling only the $1-5m band gives an SE of 0.22 points, $5-25m 0.18 and <$1m 0.17 (1h, central), against 0.04 for the $25-100m band. More ≥$25m returns cannot narrow the interval further

question: Measure the DAF dollars that go to recipients with no FY2023-24 Form 990 or 990-EZ (congregations, 990-N filers): 228 of the 300 supplementary EINs in no_ntee <$1m and religion <$1m had no 990/990-EZ in the IRS TEOS index. conclusion_affected: Scope statement of the recipient DAF share; church and small-recipient DAF reliance
rationale: The weights treat these EINs as out of scope (they keep their place in n_h), which is right for a line-1h share but means the share says nothing about them.
